story: The Keeper's hook and close for the compilation The Complete Story of Noah (Genesis 5-9, KJV), said to the camera in 2 segments (his own words, apart from scripture)

narration.text: What if obeying God meant building a ship with no rain in sight? Here is Noah's whole story, Genesis five to nine.
Noah did all that God commanded him, before one drop fell. So what is God asking of you, that you cannot yet see?

shots.prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, cinema camera, fine film grain. Close-up from the chest up, his face large in the centre of the frame, static camera. The narrator, an original elderly storyteller of about seventy with Middle Eastern features, weathered warm olive skin with deep lines on the forehead, kind deep-set brown eyes, a very long silver-white beard and long silver hair under a hooded brown wool robe, seated cross-legged by a small campfire at night under a starry desert sky, holding an old rolled scroll in both hands, centred in the frame holds his head level and looks straight into the camera and speaks to the camera, his lips moving clearly with every word, a grave, intent look. Night in the open desert, the campfire's warm flicker on his face, deep blue darkness and stars behind him. Hushed and urgent. No text, no logos.
